claim: The shadow pass is the first draw pass of every captured frame and one contiguous block: SetRenderTarget(0, R16F|R32F map), SetDepthStencilSurface(D24X8), Clear(target|z, 0xffffffff, 1.0), the casters, then the next SetRenderTarget; no D3DPERF event marks it. Same shape in land_40 at both poses and in siege_small, at 8192 with the release values on: the first draw pass, one block, 47-61 draws, no D3DPERF event. The receivers run in three later targets: 960 reflection, 960 refraction, the main 1920 pass
